scripts.generate-db: npm run migrate && npm run migrate-apply && npm run generate
scripts.generate: prisma generate --sql && shx rm prisma/generated/runtime/library.js && shx cp src/prisma-runtime-library.js prisma/generated/runtime/library.js
scripts.generate2: shx rm -rf prisma/generated && prisma generate --sql && shx rm prisma/generated/runtime/library.js && shx cp src/prisma-runtime-library.js prisma/generated/runtime/library.js
scripts.migrate: npx prisma migrate diff --from-empty --to-schema-datamodel prisma/schema.prisma --script > prisma/init.sql
